canonical_title: Higgsfield raises $400 million Series B at $5.4 billion valuation
treatment: Treat the August 17 Series B, $5.4B valuation, $700M annualized revenue and 30M-user adoption figures as covered. Reinclude only for a new funding close, material revenue/customer update, major proprietary model or agent release, acquisition, or infrastructure/product disclosure that changes practical interpretation.
known_facts: Reuters reported on August 17 that Higgsfield raised $400 million in a Series B led by DST Capital, with participation from Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Tribe Capital, Intel Capital and existing investors.
The round valued Higgsfield at $5.4 billion, roughly four times its valuation about six months earlier.
Higgsfield said annualized revenue reached $700 million in August 2026.
The company said global users had doubled since January to more than 30 million.
Funding is intended for global sales and management expansion plus infrastructure, research and hiring.
reinclude_only_if: Higgsfield announces a major proprietary model, agent runtime or infrastructure release.
Revenue, enterprise adoption or user scale changes materially with credible new figures.
A new financing, acquisition, strategic partnership or material corporate transaction closes.
Independent evidence materially changes the interpretation of production adoption or economics.
notes: NEW in 2026-08-17 Night: selected as a concrete adoption/economics signal for generative media infrastructure rather than as a model-release story.
